content.title: Why Did Catherine Harding Break Up With Jude Law? Inside Their Split Amid Jorginho-Chappell Roan Row
content.text: Catherine Harding's personal life has once again made headlines after her recent conflict with singer, Chappell Roan. She is known for being a contestant on The Voice UK and a cast member for the series Married to the Game. But the British singer-songwriter, known as Cat Cavelli, has not just gained attention for her work, but also for her high-profile relationships. Whether it was her brief romance with actor, Jude Law or her marriage to footballer, Jorginho, Catherine's life has always intrigued fans. Amid her and her husband's clash with Chappell Roan, know what led to her split with Jude. Why did Catherine Harding break up with Jude Law? Catherine Harding and Jude Law's relationship dates back to early 2014, when they met on the set of the film, Spy in the Czech Republic. After dating in the spotlight for a few months, they decided to part ways. According to People, their relationship ended before Catherine announced she was expecting their child in a few months. Unlike many other celebrity breakups, Catherine and Jude did not face any major controversy or public fallout following their separation. Instead, sources close to them claimed they had a brief relationship, and things between them did not develop into a long-term bond. Despite the pregnancy, they parted ways and focused on co-parenting their daughter, Ada, who was born in 2015. Since then, Catherine admitted that Jude has been a supportive parent. Although they do not have a romantic bond, they remain respectful and cordial, avoiding public disputes. After their breakup, Catherine and Jude established a stable co-parenting bond. According to her old interviews, the British singer said Jude was a "great dad" to their daughter. Later, Jude married and focused on his acting career, while Catherine focused on her music and television appearances. Continue reading below Catherine Harding and Jorginho Frello's love story Several years after her breakup with Jude Law, Catherine Harding again found love in Jorginho Frello. The exact details of her first meeting with Italian footballer is not available to the public. But they reportedly began dating in 2019 away from the media spotlight. Gradually, their love grew, and the relationship became stronger. Eventually, the footballer popped the question to her in 2023, and they tied the knot in an extravagant wedding in Lake Como, Italy, in 2025. The couple shares a son born in 2020, and apart from Catherine's daughter with Jude, they also have a blended family, including Jorginho's two daughters from his previous relationship. In turn, the singer has been open about the realities of managing such a family dynamic that requires effort, patience, and constant communication. Despite the challenges, the couple has often presented a united front. What caused Jorginho Frello and Chappell Roan's conflict? Catherine Harding recently made headlines after an incident with singer, Chappell Roan during a trip to Brazil. She and her daughter, Ada, allegedly had an upsetting encounter with the singer's security personal at a hotel in São Paulo. According to media outlets, the matter became great when a security guard allegedly spoke harshly to Ada, leaving the young girl upset. It quickly gained attention, with Jorginho stepping in to defend his family. Although details remain limited, the footballer reportedly expressed strong concern over how the situation was handled.
